name: Logo Reveal
description: Particles converge into your flat logo and hold for two seconds. Give it the logo as a reference image, not as a start frame.
prompt: Abstract particles in {{colors}} converge and settle into the flat logo from image 1, then hold still for two seconds on a {{bg}} background, clean motion design, subtle whoosh
negative_prompt: distorted logo, extra letters, text, flicker

slots.name: logo
slots.label: Logo
slots.help: A flat logo on a plain or transparent background.
